question.question:
A company's fiscal year runs 1 January to 31 December (January is month 1). On the first day of month 3 it pays 3960 USD in cash for an insurance policy covering exactly 6 months from that date. Insurance expense is recognized evenly per month of coverage; any coverage not yet used at 31 December is carried as a prepaid asset. On the first day of month 8 it draws a loan of 580000 USD at 10.75 percent per year. Interest accrues on the full principal every month at one-twelfth of the annual rate and is paid in cash in arrears at the end of each 3-month period counted from the drawdown date; if a payment date falls on 31 December it is paid that day. Interest accrued but not yet paid at 31 December is an accrued liability. Compute the total expense recognized in the fiscal year for insurance plus loan interest, regardless of cash paid.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.
